verdict_reason: The consignment contact tests are removed correctly, but a bad rebase also deletes every germinal products add-page test that openspec coverage still links.

todos.issue: The PR deletes the whole '#addressBookAddController — germinal products journey handshake' describe block (seven tests: germinal consignor GET, own-return GET, own-return Save and select, own-return Cancel, Save and select with hand-back log, Save and return, Cancel), not only its consignment contact test. The germinal products journey is still registered (journey-registry.js:43 JOURNEY_TYPES.GBN_AG_GERMINAL_PRODUCTS) and openspec/coverage/ins/address-book/coverage.json:6110 and :6188 still link two of these titles, so the spec now claims coverage by tests that no longer exist. Commit 70533d89 was rebased over main's 75aac721 (which added these tests) and took the pre-germinal version of the file.
todos.fix: Must: every germinal products add-page behaviour that main tested is still tested, and only the 'germinal products consignment contact handshake saves the address as a Branch address' test is gone; every coverage.json link on the germinal products scenarios names a test that exists. One way: restore the describe block from origin/main (b9109426) and delete only its last test.
